title: Ticket HD-27-04502: Cafeteria Card Readers Down

fields.requester: Main Cafeteria Supervisor – Food Service (night shift)
fields.location: Main Cafeteria – Serving Line, Registers 1 and 2
fields.subject: Main cafeteria POS: 'PAYMENT HOST UNREACHABLE' on both terminals
fields.description: Main cafeteria: both point-of-sale terminals show 'PAYMENT HOST UNREACHABLE' and won't take badge payroll deduction or cards. Night staff coming off shift can't buy breakfast and day shift is arriving. Cafeteria supervisor asks if this is 'the hack spreading' and whether she should close the line.

activity.author: IS Help Desk – night technician
activity.text: Food service vendor says their card processor posted an East Coast outage at 06:05. Should I escalate to the command center?

activity.author: IS Help Desk – night technician
activity.text: Got your call. We're looking at it now. Please keep the terminals powered on and don't restart them until we call you back.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket created via ext. 5500 (phone). Priority set to Moderate (Impact: Medium / Urgency: Medium). Assigned to group IS Help Desk.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The cafeteria outage comes from the food service vendor's outside card processor and has nothing to do with Lakemont's storage failure. The CNO and LPM should leave it with the help desk and facilities, perhaps suggest a cash or IOU line for staff, keep analysts and security on the replay, and avoid feeding the hacking rumor.
